Mathematical review at local 79dacf69 identifies a concrete upstream rank-geometry issue and a justified reference alternative. See docs/verification/umvpa-rank-math-review-20261007/README.md and docs/plans/unified-mvpa-rank-method-plan-v2.md. Euclidean coefficient completion agrees with published PermCCA but makes later permutation tails coordinate-dependent (H2 642/720 versus 672/720 after an invertible shear; independent R and JVM/JS production checks). Repair in whitened score/covariance geometry with explicit tied-root policy and affine-invariance fixtures; a geometry repair alone does not establish partial-null validity.

The next implementation packet also specifies a conservative Gaussian interlacing reference for the existing unscaled Wilks tail, dimensions (a-s,b), zero-mean residual rows m=n-rank(Z), independent Monte Carlo reference streams, then closure. Keep exact method identity and conservative/approximate claims distinct; no admission before M4.09/M4.10 requirements. This is an explicit prospective proposal, not a frozen v2 protocol. M4.07 remains doing.
